project_type_use_case: building or civil construction, execution phase
record_grain: one cost risk or work package per row
field_names_and_types: risk_id str; wbs_id str; description str; optimistic_cost float; most_likely_cost float; pessimistic_cost float; distribution enum(triangular,betapert); probability float; correlation_group str; currency str
units: currency units and probability as a proportion
period_structure: one snapshot per reporting period, 6 periods
valid_ranges: costs >= 0; optimistic <= most_likely <= pessimistic; probability in [0,1]
canonical_edge_cases: a zero-range risk (all three equal); a certainty (probability 1); a single dominant risk; a fully correlated group; an empty register
known_answer_fixture: three work packages of 100,000 each with ranges (90,100,130) thousand and probability 1, so the analytic Beta-PERT mean is (90 + 4*100 + 130)/6 = 103.33 thousand per package and the deterministic collapse of a zero-range register is exactly the baseline
ground_truth_outputs: P50 and P80 forecast at completion computed analytically for the zero-range and single-risk cases

project_type_use_case: linear or repetitive works, for example paving, piping or fit-out floors
record_grain: one crew and location and period
field_names_and_types: location_id str; location_sequence int; crew_id str; trade str; planned_rate_units_per_day float; actual_rate_units_per_day float; quantity float; unit_of_measure str; start_date date; finish_date date; buffer_days float
units: units per day; days; the quantity unit named in unit_of_measure
period_structure: one production record per crew per location per reporting period
valid_ranges: rates > 0; sequence unique and contiguous; buffer_days >= 0
canonical_edge_cases: a follower faster than its leader; a crew that stops entirely for a period; a single location; a leader and follower at identical rates so the lag is exactly zero
known_answer_fixture: 20 units, leader 2.0 units per day, follower 1.62 units per day, initial buffer 5.0 days: lag = 1/1.62 - 1/2.0 = 0.117284 days per unit and the minimum buffer at unit 20 is 2.654 days
ground_truth_outputs: minimum buffer, the first unit at which the buffer falls to the warning level, and the band, computed by hand per fixture

project_type_use_case: any project with an activity network and aggressive-plus-buffer estimating
record_grain: one activity, plus one buffer per chain
field_names_and_types: activity_id str; name str; chain enum(critical,feeding); aggressive_duration_days float; safe_duration_days float; actual_duration_days float; pct_complete float; buffer_id str; buffer_type enum(project,feeding); buffer_size_days float; buffer_consumed_days float; period str
units: days; per cent complete as 0 to 100
minimum_record_count: 25 activities, 1 project buffer, 3 feeding buffers, 6 periods
recommended_record_count: 80 activities, 1 project buffer, 8 feeding buffers, 12 periods
period_structure: one consumption record per buffer per period
valid_ranges: durations > 0; aggressive <= safe; pct_complete in [0,100]; consumed >= 0
canonical_edge_cases: zero chain completion (the degenerate point this run found reads Amber); a fully consumed buffer; a chain complete with the buffer untouched; a feeding buffer breached while the project buffer is clean
known_answer_fixture: project buffer 30 days sized as half the sum of the safe-minus-aggressive differences; at 40 per cent chain complete and 12 days consumed the fever chart position is 40 per cent consumed against a 40 per cent Amber edge and a 60 per cent Red edge
ground_truth_outputs: buffer consumption per cent, chain completion per cent, and the fever-chart zone per period

project_type_use_case: any project with a formal quality audit programme
field_names_and_types: audit_id str; audit_date date; scope str; total_findings int; finding_id str; severity enum(minor,major,critical); status enum(open,closed); raised_date date; closed_date date; period str
period_structure: one audit per two reporting periods; findings carried across periods until closed
canonical_edge_cases: an audit with no findings; a backlog equal to the cohort; a backlog of zero with a large cohort; a period with an audit but no new findings
known_answer_fixture: 6 open of an audited cohort of 40 gives an open ratio of exactly 0.15, which is the first Yellow value because the Green edge is exclusive
ground_truth_outputs: open ratio and band per period, hand-computed

project_type_use_case: any project with a constraint or look-ahead process, for example last-planner style planning
record_grain: one work item arriving at one station
field_names_and_types: station_id str; station_name str; servers int; queue_discipline enum(fifo,priority); item_id str; arrival_timestamp datetime; station_id str; service_start datetime; service_end datetime; priority int; period str
period_structure: arrivals timestamped continuously, aggregated to reporting periods
valid_ranges: service_end >= service_start >= arrival; servers >= 1; arrival rate > 0
canonical_edge_cases: a station with zero arrivals in a period; utilisation above one (an unstable queue); a single server saturated; a burst arrival
known_answer_fixture: arrival rate 8 items per day, service rate 10 per day, one server: utilisation 0.8 and the M/M/1 expected queue length is 0.8^2/(1-0.8) = 3.2 items
ground_truth_outputs: utilisation, expected queue length and expected wait per station per period, from the closed-form M/M/1 result

record_grain: one agent and one state transition
field_names_and_types: agent_id str; agent_type enum(supplier,fabricator,shipper,installer); item_id str; state enum(ordered,fabricating,shipped,delivered,installed,delayed); state_entered date; rule_id str; trigger_state str; condition str; resulting_state str; probability float; period str
period_structure: state transitions dated, aggregated to reporting periods
valid_ranges: probability in [0,1] and the rules leaving any state must sum to 1; dates monotone per agent
canonical_edge_cases: an agent that never leaves its initial state; a rule set with a cycle; an empty log; every agent at risk
known_answer_fixture: 20 agents with a delay rule firing at probability 0.15 gives an expected at-risk share of exactly 0.15, that is 3 of 20, which is the first Yellow value because the Green edge is exclusive
ground_truth_outputs: the at-risk share per period, and the stationary distribution of the transition matrix

field_names_and_types: permit_id str; permit_type str; issuing_authority str; condition_id str; condition_text str; assessment_id str; assessment_date date; conditions_assessed int; conditions_met int; violations int; period str
units: counts; the rate as a percentage
canonical_edge_cases: full compliance; a single violation; an assessment with no conditions in scope; a rate of exactly 95 per cent (the inclusive Green edge)
known_answer_fixture: 38 of 40 conditions met gives a rate of exactly 95.0 per cent, which is Green because the edge is inclusive; 37 of 40 gives 92.5 per cent and Yellow
ground_truth_outputs: compliance rate and band per period

project_type_use_case: any project; this is the single shared schedule corpus
record_grain: one activity, one logic tie, one period snapshot
field_names_and_types: activity_id str; name str; optimistic_days float; most_likely_days float; pessimistic_days float; actual_days float; early_start date; early_finish date; late_start date; late_finish date; total_float_days float; free_float_days float; is_critical bool; calendar_id str; predecessor_id str; relationship enum(FS,SS,FF,SF); lag_days int; snapshot_date date; period str
relationships: predecessors both ends -> activities; schedule_snapshots.activity_id -> activities; activities.calendar_id -> calendars
period_structure: one full snapshot per reporting period so float history is derivable
valid_ranges: durations > 0; optimistic <= most_likely <= pessimistic; no cycles; float may be NEGATIVE and that is not an error
canonical_edge_cases: a negative-float path; parallel paths of equal length so criticality is shared; a single-activity project; an activity with zero float exactly; a calendar with non-working days spanning a period boundary
known_answer_fixture: the three-activity network the schedule modules currently hard-code, A = (8,10,14), then B = (12,15,22) parallel with C = (10,13,18): the deterministic critical path on the modes is 10 + 15 = 25 days, and the P80 of the sum must be compared against the P80 of the baseline, not against the sum of the modes, which is the defect this run reports
ground_truth_outputs: deterministic CPM early and late dates, total and free float per activity, and the P50 and P80 project duration by analytic convolution for the three-activity fixture
